memory.title: Memory
memory.description: What {{project}}'s agents remember across tasks. Only active records reach agents; records they propose wait here for you.
memory.settingsUnbuilt: Project settings › Memory isn't built yet: the saving rules and limits can't be changed in this version.
memory.personOnly: Only a person changes memory here: input from an MCP client is refused, as what records say reaches every later agent. Clients can still read this page.
memory.loadStillWorks: Agents keep working with what their prompts already hold.

tabs.waitingNote: Agents get a record from their next invocation after you approve it. Until then no agent receives it.
tabs.activeNote: Only active records reach agents: their task’s latest handoff, pinned records, decisions and warnings, then the best matches for their step. Grouped by type · pinned first.
tabs.deprecatedNote: A record you deprecate stops reaching agents and is kept here; you can restore it.
tabs.settingsNote: How agents' records are kept in {{project}}, and how much memory each agent gets.

empty.waitingBody: Records agents propose for {{project}} and its tasks wait here until you approve or reject them.
empty.activeBody: No record reaches agents yet. Approve a proposal or write a record.
empty.deprecatedBody: A record you deprecate stops reaching agents and is kept here; you can restore it.
empty.supersededBody: When a newer record replaces one, the older version is kept here and in the newer record's history.
empty.rejectedBody: Proposals you reject are kept here and never given to agents. So are proposals an agent replaced with a newer one before anyone decided.

settings.taskMemoryBody: Handoffs, decisions and warnings agents record while they work on one task.
settings.projectMemoryBody: Facts and decisions agents record for every task of {{project}}.
settings.taskAutomatic: Records agents write are kept at once. You can edit, deprecate or delete them in the task's Memory tab.
settings.taskAfterApproval: Each record an agent proposes waits in Memory until you approve it. No agent gets it before.
settings.projectAutomatic: Records agents write for the whole project are kept at once and given to agents in every task.
settings.projectAfterApproval: Each project record an agent proposes waits in Memory › Waiting for approval until you approve it.
settings.recordsBody: The best-matching active records an agent gets when it starts or resumes, pinned ones first.
settings.tokensBody: The most memory text one invocation gets. Lower-ranked records are left out once it is reached.
settings.nextNote: Changes apply to the next agent invocation. An agent already working keeps the memory it was given when it started or resumed.
settings.peopleNote: Agents propose and supersede records. Only people approve, edit, deprecate or delete them. Waiting proposals are never given to an agent.
settings.invalid: Not saved · fix the marked field
settings.failed: Not saved · Orchester couldn't write the settings
settings.personOnly: Only a person changes these settings: input from an MCP client is refused, as they decide what reaches every later agent. Clients can still read this page.

meta.withdrawn: replaced by its newer proposal before anyone decided

proposal.note: Agents don't receive it until you approve.

tabSearch.waiting: No records waiting for approval match “{{query}}”

noMatch.lexical: Search finds words and parts of words in the text, keys and tags of records. It doesn't know synonyms, so try another word.
noMatch.lexicalShort: Search finds words and parts of words, not other wording with the same meaning.

editor.newSubtitle: A record you write for {{project}}'s agents
editor.saveToHint: A record a person writes is active at once.
editor.pinned: Pinned · always give it to agents
editor.pinnedHint: Pinned records reach every invocation of this task before any match, within the record and token limits.
editor.pinnedHintProject: Pinned records reach every invocation of the project's tasks before any match, within the record and token limits.
editor.replacesText: It becomes superseded and stops reaching agents; its history stays with this record.
editor.replacesTextDiff: The active record becomes superseded: it stops reaching agents and stays in this record's history. Agents get the new text from their next invocation.
editor.confidenceValue: {{confidence}} · set by {{agent}}; people don't change it
editor.author: Author
editor.authorKept: your edit keeps the author and adds edited by you
editor.rejectNote: Rejected proposals are kept and never given.
editor.approveNote: Your edits are saved with the approval.
editor.approveNotePage: Your edits are saved with the approval. Rejected proposals are kept and never given.
editor.saveNote: Changes reach agents from their next invocation.

delete.title: Delete this record?
delete.givenNone: It stops reaching agents from their next invocation; no invocation was given it.
delete.givenOne: It stops reaching agents from their next invocation, and the invocation that was given it shows Deleted record.
delete.givenOther: It stops reaching agents from their next invocation, and the {{count}} invocations that were given it show Deleted record.
delete.givenUnknown: It stops reaching agents from their next invocation, and invocations that were given it show Deleted record.
delete.earlierOne: Its 1 earlier version is deleted with it.
delete.earlierOther: Its {{count}} earlier versions are deleted with it.
delete.deprecateHint: To stop giving it to agents but keep it and its history, deprecate it instead.

unreadable.one: 1 record couldn't be read and is left out
unreadable.other: {{count}} records couldn't be read and are left out
unreadable.body: They are missing from this list, from search and from what agents get. The project database keeps their rows as they are.

inspector.author: Author
inspector.givenNone: No invocation was given it yet.
inspector.confidenceKept: {{confidence}} · set by {{agent}}; people don't change it
inspector.authorKept: your edit keeps the author and adds edited by you

next.title: Next agent receives
next.chosen: Chosen the way the next prompt is built.
next.chosenFor: Chosen the way {{agent}}'s next prompt is built.
next.recordLimitOne: The record limit left out 1 lower-ranked match.
next.recordLimit: The record limit left out {{count}} lower-ranked matches.
next.tokenLimitOne: The token limit left out 1 lower-ranked match.
next.tokenLimit: The token limit left out {{count}} lower-ranked matches.
next.nothing: Nothing to give yet: the next prompt has no Task memory part. No project record matches this task.
next.none: No agent step of this task works or waits to start, so nothing is chosen for one.
next.unreadable: Can't show what the next agent receives until task memory can be read.
next.footnote: Ranked by matching words, importance, recency, role and confidence. Waiting proposals are never given.

task.emptyTitle: No memory for this task yet
task.emptyBody: Agents keep a handoff when a step passes or fails, with the decisions it made; you can write records too.
task.emptyWorking: {{step}} is working: its handoff appears here when the step ends.
task.loadFailedBody: {{reason}} Nothing was changed; agents keep working with what their prompts already hold.
